rca of the issue: Statement upload 500: Backend trace from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log clearly shows `pypdf.errors.PdfReadError: startxref not found` bubbling up unhandled through the statements/upload route handler. The sibling /invoices/upload route catches this exact exception and returns a 422 with a friendly message, so the statements route is just missing the same try/except wrapper. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/statements/upload -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@/tmp/test_sample.pdf` where test_sample.pdf is a truncated/invalid PDF. Expected: 422 JSON. Actual: 500 'Internal Server Error' (plain text). Mitigation: add `except (pypdf.errors.PdfReadError, Exception) as e:` around the pypdf.PdfReader(...) call in the statement upload handler (same shape as invoices_routes.py). Landing↔catalog mismatch RCA: Landing.jsx has an in-line array of 8 report card objects (icon, title, body, tone) hard-coded in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx at ~lines 311-325. The copy drifted from REPORT_TYPES in /app/backend/reports_routes.py:104 at some point without a cross-link. There is no public catalog endpoint — GET /api/public/reports/catalog returns 404 — so the frontend has no way to self-check. The previous session's search_replace sweep for 'web Landing reports list to the backend catalog' claim appears to have missed this file.
